chore(deps): pin lernapps/tooling d31a42a: site-deploy keeps the copies of listed apps

## Intent

The root site must use the tooling whose deploy keeps the copies of listed apps before the apps repo starts publishing them. Otherwise the next deploy of the home page deletes them.

## Key changes

- The workflows and the pre-push hook pin lernapps/tooling d31a42a (lernapps/tooling#127): the deploy of the home page leaves the copies in copies.txt alone.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs tooling 7dbcb8a; allows the merge of apps 880b129.
